title: Can Network Models of Science Do Without Pluralist Agents?
title_zh: 科学的网络模型能否离开多元主义智能体？

paragraphs.en: 研究构建多智能体变分推断模型，验证费耶阿本德理论多元主义如何促进科学社群的集体信念演化。 Science is a process of useful models being proven wrong time and again, but despite its many flaws, it somehow works. Why is this? Paul Feyerabend argued that it works because people dare to hold and defend incompatible rival theories against the accepted one, since a theory's failures often lead to its abandonment in the presence of a more accurate or simpler alternative. He called this view theoretical pluralism. We introduce a theoretical and experimental model in which this can be examined. It compares communities of pluralist agents, which can hold rival theories side by side and maintain beliefs within and between those theories, with communities of monist agents, which can only incorporate what they hear or observe into a single model of their own. In a multi-agent variational inference setting, our experimental demonstrations illustrate how communities with rival theories can go through periods of uncertainty followed by a shift in the theories they hold true, how the information that is communicated between communities affects beliefs when those communities make different observations about the world, and how sharing support for theories and sharing beliefs within them contribute differently to collective belief dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究构建多智能体变分推断模型，验证费耶阿本德的理论多元主义如何促进科学社群的集体信念演化。科学是一个有用模型不断被证伪的过程，尽管存在诸多缺陷，它却总能奏效。这是为什么？ 保罗·费耶阿本德认为，科学之所以奏效，是因为人们敢于持有并捍卫与公认理论不相容的对抗性理论，因为当存在更精确或更简洁的替代理论时，一个理论的失败往往会导致它被放弃。 他将这一观点称为理论多元主义。 我们引入了一个可以对这一问题进行考察的理论与实验模型。 该模型将多元主义智能体社群与一元主义智能体社群进行比较：前者可以并行持有对抗性理论，并在理论内部和理论之间维持信念；后者只能将听到或观察到的东西纳入自己的单一模型。 在多智能体变分推断的设定下，我们的实验演示说明了：持有对抗性理论的社群如何经历不确定时期并随后转变其所信奉的理论；当社群对世界做出不同的观察时，社群之间传递的信息如何影响信念；以及对理论的支持共享与理论内部的信念共享如何对集体信念动态产生不同的贡献。
